regulation_text: (a) Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and confidentiality of electronic records. (b) Persons who use closed systems shall use authority checks to ensure that only authorized individuals can use the system. (c) Persons who develop, maintain, or use electronic record systems shall have the education, training, and experience to perform their assigned tasks.
